Suvendu Adhikari releases 1993 police firing report, questions Mamata Banerjee

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari publicly released a commission report on the July 21, 1993 police firing incident. Adhikari stated that Mamata Banerjee, who had claimed to be a prime witness, was not questioned by the commission. He alleged that the Trinamool Congress (TMC) government used the 1993 firing for political gains. The report's release occurred ahead of the TMC's Martyrs' Day rally.
